$comment: Classes of a raw <button> that is not an action button of the system (#1233). Every action is a Button (ui-btn) or an IconButton (ui-icon-btn); a control of one of these kinds may carry its own class. app/tests/app/button-system-core.test.ts fails on a <button> with none of them and on an entry no button uses, so this list can only shrink. A new screen does not add a class here: it uses Button. docs/design/final/README.md, Buttons.

menu.description: An option of a menu, a list sheet, a popover list or a picker's grid (a calendar day, an emoji). The container draws it; it is not an action button.

trigger.description: A control that opens a menu, a panel or a picker and shows its current value, like a field. Dropdowns of plain values use Select.

row.description: A whole row, card or tile that opens something. The row is the target, so it carries no button of its own.

inline.description: A text action inside a sentence or a status line: underlined text, the weight of the words around it.

chip.description: A chip or a pill that stands for a value or a suggestion.

dismiss.description: An icon-only cross or control on a surface that is not a toolbar: it closes, clears or removes what it sits on.

shell.description: A control of the application shell or of a screen's header, drawn in the final design as its own part: the sidebar, the phone's bar, panels.

composer.description: A control of the composer, of a message or of an attachment on a photo: icon controls and sheet rows.

segmented.description: An option of a segmented control that is not a radio group (a pressed pair).

canvas.description: A tool of the map's canvas or its outline: the canvas has its own tool language.

hidden.description: A visually hidden button for assistive technology.
